## Professional Summary
Senior Frontend Developer with over 6 years of experience architecting and shipping mission-critical web applications across Dubai, UAE and international engineering teams. Proven track record in high-frequency trading platforms (sub-12ms WebSocket streams), PropTech compliance pipelines (Shufti biometric OCR and digital Power of Attorney payment gateways), and Web3 decentralized platforms serving 150K+ active users.

## Verified Career Highlights

  - Integrated Shufti KYC automated biometric verification and digital Power of Attorney (POA) payment calculation flows.
  - Overhauled Core Web Vitals performance score from 42/100 to 99/100, dropping Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) from 3.8s to 0.4s.
- **Coinroutes**: Senior Frontend Engineer (High-Frequency Crypto Trading Platform).
  - Engineered real-time orderbook depth streaming using WebSockets with requestAnimationFrame batching, achieving sub-12ms UI latency.
  - Modernized legacy Redux Saga codebase into modular Redux Toolkit slices, reducing boilerplate by 65%.
- **TNC IT Solutions (Dubai, UAE)**: Senior Frontend Engineer (Web3 DEX & NFT Marketplace).
  - Built scalable trading interfaces handling over 150,000 active concurrent users using Socket.IO and Web3 wallet connectors.
- **CoolShop SRL**: Frontend Engineer (E-Commerce Platforms).
- **Factweavers Technologies**: Frontend & Web Extraction Engineer.
